description.zh: 在设置中勾选并确认后，员工可复用 GitHub CLI 和 TapTap CLI 的现有登录会话执行列表内的只读命令，不读取或复制登录密钥。
description.en: After selection and confirmation in Settings, employees can reuse existing GitHub CLI and TapTap CLI sessions for listed read-only commands. Login keys are never read or copied.

mcpServers.name: office-cli
mcpServers.description: Use explicitly authorized local CLI sessions for bounded read-only GitHub and TapTap operations. No auth, token, write, shell or arbitrary file access.
